# Learning Bird

> > Learning Bird empowers Indigenous education through culturally responsive curriculum development, language revitalization, and decolonized classroom practices across Canada.

Learning Bird is a platform dedicated to supporting First Nations, Métis, and Inuit educators and communities in developing and implementing Indigenous-centered curricula. The organization partners with schools and educational institutions across Canada to provide resources, professional development, and services that integrate Indigenous knowledge, languages, and pedagogies into classroom learning.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous education
- Language revitalization
- First Nations Educators' Conference (FNEC)
- Decolonized curriculum
- Indigenous languages
- Cultural education
- Classroom practice
- Professional development
- First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities
- Language learning
- Indigenous Knowledge & Wisdom Centre
- Curriculum digitization
- Community-led learning
- Water justice
- Educational partnerships
